sha256-hdi-v1:5217a7b285b3974c0f57118b54.description: Race in a PC-98 Grand Prix game from West Side, released in 1990. Compete on circuits and manage the demands of high-speed driving rather than navigating an adventure story.
sha256-hdi-v1:5217a7b285b3974c0f57118b54.title: Grand Prix Circus

sha256-hdi-v1:52a7efb1044e4c9a85ad09ff71.description: Eimmy searches for her missing stepbrother after debt collectors tear apart her family life. This illustrated adventure follows her investigation and the contrasting personality she discovers within herself.
sha256-hdi-v1:52a7efb1044e4c9a85ad09ff71.title: Amy to Yobanaide
